children: Eurozone government bond yields fall in opening trade, shrugging off interest-rate hike expectations and heavy bond supply on Thursday. Spain and France line up for bond issuance, with the former offering 4.5 billion euros to 5.5 billion euros in government bonds and the latter auctioning a combined 11.25 billion euros to 13.75 billion euros in a total of eight nominal and inflation-linked bonds. The 10-year Bund yield declines 0.8 basis points to 3.363%, according to Tradeweb. "Ten-year Bund yields remain within their recently established range just below 3.4%, but volatility is picking up amid hawkish central bank talk and shaky risk sentiment," Commerzbank's Hauke Siemssen says in a note.
